profile.headline: Software Developer III at Primerica Financial Services

positions.title: CGI Federal, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented J2EE web application that provided the ability to transfer needed parts between 22 military sites. The application used Struts and JSPs for the presentation layer and Spring for data access on an Oracle Weblogic Server.
Ported weekly report to database by creating stored procedure using SQL in a Sybase database, improving processing time by 90%.
Developed portion of website that handled the creation of projects and funding in excess of one million dollars for military work orders.
Enhanced functionality of J2EE web application using JavaScript and JQuery framework to improve user experience.
Hardened Oracle Weblogic 10.3.0 server to required army DIACAP standards for security.

positions.title: Accenture, Programmer/Senior Programmer/QA Tester
positions.description:
BellSouth 

Performed analysis and documentation of test results using Mercury Test Director.
 Assisted in late night team testing for features added to telephone and DSL ordering website.
 Edited and ran UNIX shell scripts generate test data for test cases. 

State of Georgia (Constituent Services Portal)

Developed presentation layer for Struts 1.3 web application to handle child support cases for constituents of the state of Georgia using JSPs to display the web content.
Leveraged Struts to validate submitted form data on the front end and server side using JavaScript and the validate method in the form beans. 
Application was finalist for 2004 Government-to-citizen category of Digital Government Achievement contest.
Produced J2EE presentation tier to display user information and passed data to .NET middle tier using SOAP Web services.
Implemented front end page to handle child support payments by credit card.
